meta.method: strings pivot (/api/strings/search + /api/strings/functions) for holder_files; function clusters via /api/function/search + /api/cluster/members; seeds via /api/yara/seed/cluster; tests via /api/yara/test (targets = holders, negatives = all other 447-n files).
meta.reading_the_tests: tp/fn = holders hit/missed. fp = hits OUTSIDE the string-pivot holders. Many of those are true sibling variants: Ghidra merges adjacent data into one longer string (e.g. DEMONS.ppc, dicknet, UPX-packed copies), so the string index undercounts holders. total_hits = tp+fp is the honest file count. The /api/yara/test scan skips ~11 unreadable files.

xor_tables.0x22: Mirai table_unlock_val: 4-byte key 0xdeadbeef folds to 0x22. Every byte ^0x22, NUL becomes '"'. e.g. '\rRPMA\r"' = '/proc/'. 80 files (prompts system/shell/enable/ncorrect), 47-51 files (proc and watchdog paths, hakai, qtxbot, data/local). YARA: match the encoded bytes, or `xor(0x22)` on the plain word.
xor_tables.0x54: Second table, key 0x54, terminator 'T'. e.g. ':7;&&17 T' = 'ncorrect', 'z5:=91T' = '.anime', '{6=:{6!'-6;,t?=88tymtT' = '/bin/busybox kill -9 '. 22 files. YARA `xor(0x54)` on the plain word.
xor_tables.note: The credential dictionary is NOT in these tables here: creds appear in clear (xc3511, vizxv, 7ujMko0vizxv, telnetadmin...), mostly in the 14 DEMONS-named files.

meta.families_seen_by_name_stem: DEMONS (14, plaintext creds), nuclear (13, gafgyt-like with SSDP/SNQUERY), boatnet (28, 'Self Rep' + 0clKiller), 'net'-named gafgyt (weednet/gaynet/dicknet/fucknet/cock..., VSE, DOMINATE, sshpass udp.py), od_* kit (10 MD5MD5-named, 3 arches), ksync persistence (6), TCP_MSGHEAD family (9 MD5-named), Josho (killer+anti-debug), Condi (11), XMRig-bundled (8), Go bots (a few)
